title.zh: 管理原理與實務 (哈佛式個案與高階決策推演)
title.en: Management Principles & Practice (Harvard Case & Strategic Decision)

slide_title.zh: VUCA 時代的管理典範轉移 (Paradigm Shift in VUCA)
slide_title.en: Management Paradigm Shift in the VUCA Era

zh: 定義當代戰場 (VUCA)：拆解易變性、不確定性、複雜性與模糊性對企業的衝擊
角色進化 (Role Evolution)：管理者必須從傳統的「指令與控制」轉型為「賦能與教練」
學習承諾 (The Hook)：我們將拋棄死背理論，學習如何將西方管理框架化為在地決策武器
en: The VUCA Battlefield: Unpacking Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity, and Ambiguity in business.
Role Evolution: Shifting the managerial mindset from 'Command & Control' to 'Empower & Coach'.
The Hook: Moving beyond textbook theory to forge practical, localized decision-making weapons.

speaker_notes.zh: 歡迎各位。在現在這個 AI 顛覆、市場瞬息萬變的 VUCA 時代，過去那種『由上而下發號施令』的管理模式已經失靈了。今天這堂課，我們不談生硬的理論，我們要談的是『生存與破局』。我們將帶大家把經典的管理學框架，轉化為你們每天都能用的決策武器。
speaker_notes.en: Welcome. In today's VUCA era—driven by AI disruption and hyper-competition—the traditional 'Command and Control' playbook is dead. Today isn't about memorizing theories; it's about survival and breakthrough. We will translate classic management frameworks into everyday decision-making weapons.

slide_title.zh: 系統性診斷與利害關係人剖析 (Systematic Diagnosis)

zh: 宏觀掃描 (Macro Scan)：運用 PESTEL 與 SWOT，精準辨識組織的系統性盲區與市場機遇
微觀衝突 (Micro Conflict)：進行利害關係人分析 (Stakeholder Mapping)，看透跨部門政治與利益
定義假說 (Hypothesis)：不要急著給答案，先針對個案現象收斂出最具價值的「核心問題假說」
en: Macro Scan: Using PESTEL and SWOT to accurately identify systemic blindspots and market opportunities.
Micro Conflict: Conducting Stakeholder Mapping to see through cross-functional politics and interests.
Core Hypothesis: Resisting the urge to jump to solutions; instead, formulating a targeted 'root problem hypothesis'.

speaker_notes.zh: 看個案就像看診。病患說他頭痛，你不能直接開止痛藥。我們必須先用 PESTEL 和 SWOT 進行全身掃描。更重要的是，在企業裡，『問題』往往牽涉到跨部門的利益衝突。我們必須透過利害關係人分析，找出隱藏在冰山底下的真正病因。
speaker_notes.en: Analyzing a case is like diagnosing a patient. You don't just prescribe painkillers for a headache. We use PESTEL and SWOT for a full-body scan. More importantly, corporate problems involve departmental turf wars. We must use stakeholder mapping to uncover the true root cause hidden beneath the iceberg.

slide_title.zh: 決策矩陣與敏捷規劃 (Decision Matrix & Agile Planning)

zh: 根本原因 (Root Cause)：運用 5 Whys 或魚骨圖，將表象症狀層層剝離至管理本質
防範認知偏差 (Cognitive Bias)：建立加權決策矩陣 (Weighted Matrix)，以客觀數據篩選最佳方案
敏捷控制 (Agile PDCA)：在充滿變數的環境中，制定具備高容錯率與快速迭代的行動藍圖
en: Root Cause Analysis: Using 5 Whys or Fishbone diagrams to strip symptoms down to management fundamentals.
Defeating Bias: Building a Weighted Decision Matrix to objectively filter alternative solutions.
Agile PDCA: Formulating action plans with high fault tolerance and rapid iteration cycles in unpredictable environments.

speaker_notes.zh: 當我們找出病因後，如何確保決策是理性的？人類很容易陷入認知偏差。因此，我們必須引入『加權決策矩陣』，讓數據來說話。同時，計畫趕不上變化，我們的控制機制必須是『敏捷 (Agile)』的，允許團隊在執行中快速修正方向。
speaker_notes.en: Once we find the cause, how do we ensure rational decision-making? Humans are prone to cognitive bias. We must introduce a Weighted Decision Matrix to let data drive the choice. Furthermore, since plans constantly change, our control mechanisms must be 'Agile', allowing teams to course-correct rapidly during execution.

slide_title.zh: 敏捷組織設計與破除穀倉 (Org Design & Silo Busting)

zh: 結構演進 (Structural Evolution)：從僵化的科層體制 (Hierarchy) 到矩陣與敏捷小隊 (Squads) 的優劣比較
破除穀倉 (Silo Busting)：探討組織設計如何影響資訊流動，並實作跨部門流程重組
變革管理 (Change Management)：套用 Kotter 8 步驟模型，有效降低組織重組時的員工抗拒感
en: Structural Evolution: Comparing rigid Hierarchies against modern Matrix and Agile Squad designs.
Silo Busting: Exploring how org design dictates information flow and how to re-engineer cross-functional workflows.
Change Management: Applying Kotter's 8-step model to systematically mitigate employee resistance during restructuring.

speaker_notes.zh: 策略再好，如果組織架構不對，也是枉然。傳統的『穀倉效應』是扼殺創新的最大兇手。這部分我們將探討如何透過組織設計打破部門藩籬。請記住，任何架構的變動都會引發反彈，所以我們必須結合 Kotter 的變革管理模型，帶領團隊走過陣痛期。
speaker_notes.en: A brilliant strategy will fail if the organizational structure is flawed. The traditional 'Silo Effect' is the ultimate innovation killer. Here, we'll discuss how to break down barriers through organizational design. Remember, any structural change triggers resistance, so we must rely on Kotter's Change Management model to guide the team through the transition.

slide_title.zh: 情境領導與心理安全感 (Situational Leadership & Trust)

zh: 心理安全感 (Psychological Safety)：打造允許試錯的基石，將個人的內在動機轉化為團隊的高效輸出
情境領導 (Situational Leadership)：沒有完美的風格；學習依據部屬的成熟度動態切換領導姿態
績效兌現 (ROI of Leadership)：整合溝通與激勵技巧，展現能在逆境中帶領團隊達成 KPI 的將才格局
en: Psychological Safety: Building a foundation of trust that tolerates failure and converts intrinsic motivation into high output.
Situational Leadership: There is no 'perfect' style; learn to dynamically adapt your approach based on team maturity.
ROI of Leadership: Integrating communication and motivation tactics to demonstrate the executive presence needed to hit KPIs in adversity.

speaker_notes.zh: 最後一哩路，是『人』。管理學研究證實，高績效團隊都有一個共同點：『心理安全感』。作為主管，你不能只有一種領導風格；面對新手與老手，你必須展現靈活的情境領導力。真正的領導，是能夠將團隊的激勵，具體兌現為公司的實質績效。
speaker_notes.en: The final mile is 'People'. Studies prove high-performing teams share one common trait: 'Psychological Safety'. As a manager, you cannot rely on a single leadership style; you must adapt dynamically depending on your team's maturity. True leadership is translating team motivation into tangible ROI and company performance.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『管理原理與實務 (Management Principles)』教學/培訓簡報。受眾為大學生或初中階主管。內容需採用哈佛商學院 (HBS) 個案教學風格，揉合高階學術理論與殘酷的商業現實。著重於：1. 帶入 VUCA 時代的典範轉移，2. 運用 PESTEL、SWOT 與利害關係人分析進行系統性診斷，3. 引入決策矩陣與敏捷 (Agile) 控制機制防範認知偏差，4. 探討破除穀倉效應與 Kotter 變革管理，5. 結合心理安全感與情境領導力。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，每字不超過一行，語氣需具備教練式引導、學術嚴謹度與極強的實務震撼力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Management Principles & Practice' training/lecture presentation in English. Audience: University students or Junior/Mid-level managers. Adopt a Harvard Business School (HBS) case method style, fusing high-level academic theory with brutal business reality. Focus on: 1. The paradigm shift in the VUCA era, 2. Systematic diagnosis using PESTEL, SWOT, and Stakeholder Mapping, 3. Mitigating cognitive bias via Decision Matrices and Agile control, 4. Silo busting and Kotter's Change Management, 5. Psychological Safety and Situational Leadership. Max 3 bullet points per slide, max one line per bullet. The tone must be coaching-oriented, academically rigorous, and practically highly impactful.
